Theme

Conversation, family & daily routines · Time, the calendar & feasts

birthday noun

also birthdays, how old will you be?, today is my birthday

classical

Traupman 280
M-O s.v. birthday
Cic.
Hor.

diēs nātālis

Other words

  • nātālis, nātālis m.

    noun, third declension · also used · classical · Traupman 280; M-O s.v. birthday; Cic.; Hor.

Examples

  • nātālī suō ipsō diē

    on her very birthday (Cicero’s little girl met him)Cic. Att. 4.1.4

  • nātālīs grātē numerās?

    do you count your birthdays gladly?Hor. Ep. 2.2.210

  • Crās est diēs nātālis tuus! Quot annōs nātus eris?

    Tomorrow’s your birthday! How old will you be?composed

  • Hodiē est meus diēs nātālis.

    Today is my birthday.Traupman 74

See also happy birthday!, birthday party, birthday present, birthday cake, holidays.

SourcesLewis & Short: natalis

John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, pp. 74, 280.
